items.title: National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and Cultus Education launch nationwide Cloud and AI skill initiative with Amazon Web Services (AWS)
items.whyInNews: On 24 August 2026 the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) partnered with Cultus Education and Amazon Web Services (AWS) to start a country‑wide program to train youth in cloud computing and artificial intelligence, aiming to up‑skill 5 million individuals by 2028.
items.summary: The National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) signed an MoU with Cultus Education and Amazon Web Services (AWS) on 24 August 2026 in New Delhi to launch a cloud and AI skill initiative. The programme targets 5 million Indian youth across urban and rural centres and will run for three years until 2028. The collaboration leverages AWS cloud infrastructure and Cultus Education's curriculum to provide certifications recognised by industry.

items.title: Indian Air Force successfully completes Pitch Black 2026 and Udara Shakti 2026 multinational exercises

items.title: Digital Agriculture and Pulse Self‑Reliance Mission achieves 100% saturation across Indian states

items.summary: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chauhan, on 24 August 2026, declared that the Digital Agriculture and Pulse Self‑Reliance Mission achieved 100% saturation across all 28 states and 8 union territories of India. items.title: Draft electoral rolls for Karnataka released on 24 August 2026 showing reduction of over 1.07 crore voters
items.whyInNews: The Karnataka State Election Commission published the draft electoral rolls on 24 August 2026, indicating that the total electorate will drop from 1.03 crore to 56.11 lakh in Bengaluru, affecting over 1.07 crore voters nationwide.
items.summary: The Karnataka State Election Commission released the draft electoral rolls on 24 August 2026, revealing that Bengaluru’s electorate will shrink from 1.03 crore to 56.11 lakh voters, a reduction of 47.89 lakh. Nationwide, the draft shows exclusion of more than 1.07 crore voters due to de‑duplication, migration updates and death removals. The final rolls are scheduled for publication on 15 September 2026, ahead of the 2026 Lok Sabha elections, ensuring accuracy for the upcoming voting process.

items.whyInNews: McLaren driver Nico Rosberg secured victory at the Dutch Grand Prix on 23 August 2026 in Zandvoort, Netherlands, completing a hat‑trick of wins for the team in the 2026 Formula 1 season
